उदुक्ष् उद्-उक्ष्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -उक्षति,
-षितुम्, to sprinkle upwards or outwards.

उदुब्ज् उद्-उब्ज्, cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, -जितुम्, to
cleave asunder (?); to set up, erect.

उदुम्बर उदुम्बर, अस्, m. (Ved. written with
द्, in later books generally with ड्), the glomerous
fig tree, Ficus Glomerata; a kind of leprosy; a thres-
hold; a eunuch; (अम्), n. the fruit of the glomerous
fig tree; copper; the weight karṣa.
—उदुम्बर-
पर्णी or उदुम्बर-दला, f., N. of the plant Croton
Polyandra.
—उदुम्बरा-वती, f., N. of a river.

उदुम्भर, a word coined for the etymological
explanation of उदुम्बर.

उदुष् उद्-उष्, cl. 1. P. -ओषति, -षितुम्, to
expel by heat.

उदुष्ट-मुख, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a red
mouth (as a horse).

उदूखल उदूखल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a wooden
mortar used for pounding rice and separating the
husk; any mortar; bdellium; a mortar-shaped joint.

उदूढ उद्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वह् with
उद्), married; coarse, gross, heavy, fat; material,
substantial; much, exceeding.

उदूह् उद्-ऊह्, cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते, -हितुम्,
to push or press upwards, move or bear upwards.
